description: Generate random lottery numbers with your own max number and count. Sorted lucky balls, optional duplicates, and a history of your draws.

faqs.a: No — and nothing can. Every draw is independent and random, so these numbers are purely for fun.
faqs.q: Can this predict winning lottery numbers?

faqs.a: The tool uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) when available, falling back to Math.random.
With duplicates off, the count can't exceed the highest number — there simply aren't enough unique numbers to draw.
faqs.q: Why can't I draw 10 numbers from 1–9 without duplicates?

howto: Set the highest number (e.g. 49) and how many numbers to draw (e.g. 6).
Keep “No duplicates” on for realistic lottery-style draws, or turn it off for repeats.
Click “Generate” to draw your sorted lucky balls.
Every draw is saved to the history list below, so you can compare sets.
title: Lottery Number Generator
